name: Overtone
description: A dark, abstract record label and sound studio: kinetic type behind the content, drawn geometric sleeves, a catalogue that filters by format and year, and a waveform with a play state but no audio.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of the Codrops Kinetic Type Page Transition, not an unchanged upstream template, and without its GSAP dependency.
No photography anywhere: twelve geometric sleeves, a level meter and a routing diagram, all written as SVG by the included scripts.
A catalogue that filters by format and year at once, and a release page whose play button moves a drawn waveform between two states with no audio file.
adaptationLabel: Adapted from Kinetic Type Page Transition
